SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. D. 117.
I. O. Chinese Section Station,
REPORT
Date April 4'th 19 29
File No...D...II7

Subject (in full) Prohibited Medicines.

Made by C. D. I. J. W. Prince. Forwarded by [签名] [签名]

Sir,
Reference to the attached we have it on good authority
that both the medicines mentioned are stimulants, and although the
sale of them is restricted, they are freely advertised and sold by
all pharmacies under cover of some form of patent medicine.
The report from the President of the Provisional Court states that
the original prescription, submitted to the Health Office, is
inconsistent with the medicine itself, and, in view of the report of
the analyst, the sale of the article should be restricted. That the
medicine is declared to be one of those that are prohibited, and on
the strength of this the President of the Provisional Court issues
a request that we take action against the manufacturers of the
medicine according to law. If it can be taken that the
Provisional Court Judges will accept and uphold the decision of the
Extra-Settlement Authorities we may then proceed to take action.
I have spoken to Mr Walker of the S.M.C. Pathological
Laboratory, and he gives a rough estimate of the cost of analysis
to be between ten and twenty Taels. It is possible that the
medicine in question contains a degree of the stimulant which may be
considered injurious to health, but in view of the fact that numerous
patent medicines which contain these stimulants and narcotics are
freely sold, I scarcely think that we would be justified in taking
action in this case, unless we can follow the decisions of the
Extra-Settlement Authorities, and are prepared to open a campaign
against all manufacturers and venders of patent medicines and drugs
in the Settlement, and that the costs of analysis in cases where the
Extra-Settlement Authorities are complainants are defrayed by the
court

A. C. P. Pol'.
[签名]
[手写批注：I recommend that no further action be taken by the S.M.P. in this case D. I. [签名]]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。 D. 117.
华务科情报站，
报告
日期 1929年4月4日
档案号...D...II7

主题（全称） 违禁药品。

由 刑事调查处督察 J. W. Prince 制作。 经由 [签名] [签名] 转呈

先生，
关于附件，我们有可靠消息来源称，
所提及的两种药品均为兴奋剂，虽然其销售受到限制，
但它们以某种专利药品的名义，在所有药房公开做广告并自由销售。
临时法院院长的报告指出，提交给卫生局的原始处方
与药品本身不符，鉴于化验员的报告，该物品的销售应受限制。
该药品被宣布为违禁药品之一，据此，临时法院院长
要求我们依法对药品制造商采取行动。如果可以认定
临时法院法官将接受并支持租界当局的决定，那么我们
便可着手采取行动。
我已与工部局病理实验室的沃克先生（Mr Walker）交谈，
他粗略估计分析费用在十至二十两之间。涉案药品可能含有
被认为有害健康的兴奋剂成分，但鉴于含有这些兴奋剂和麻醉剂
的众多专利药品均在自由销售，我认为除非我们能遵循
租界当局的决定，并准备对在租界内所有专利药品和药物
的制造商及销售商开展一场打击行动，且由法院承担
租界当局作为投诉人的案件中的分析费用，否则我们在此案中
采取行动的理由并不充分。

助理警司（警务）。
[签名]
[手写批注：我建议工部局警务处在此案中不再采取进一步行动 刑事调查处主任 [签名]]

Shanghai Municipal Council.
PHONE
12049
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
PROSECUTING SOLICITOR'S OFFICE.
Shanghai, March 28, 1929.
Acting Director of Criminal Intelligence.
Re: Prohibited Medicines
According to the attached report of the Health Officer
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai I am unable to form an
opinion as to whether or not prosecution should be instituted
against the manufacturer of the medicine called "Boy Scouts".
The report does not set forth the detail. amount and kind of
ingredients contained in the said medicine, nor does it contain
an expert opinion of the effect of each ingredient to public
health or morals.
Article 19 of the Chinese Government Regulations governing
chemists provides:
If any medicine having been examined by a health inspector
is found to be injurious to health or to be against public morals or
to be false, the proper authorities may prohibit the manufacturing,
storage, or sale of the same and the said medicine may be destroyed
or otherwise disposed of.
Unless we know more about this medicine I advise not to
take any action in the matter.
O. C.
AMB
King S. Kum
Assistant Police Advocate.

上海公共租界工部局。
电话
12049
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL 上海公共租界工部局）
公诉律师办公室。
上海，1929年3月28日。
代理刑事情报主任。
事由：违禁药品
根据大上海市政府卫生官员的附件报告，
我无法就是否应对名为“童子军”（Boy Scouts）的药品
制造商提起诉讼形成意见。该报告未列明
所述药品中所含成分的具体数量、种类，也未包含
关于每种成分对公共卫生或道德影响的专业意见。
中国政府管理药剂师的法规第19条规定：
如果经卫生检查员检查发现任何药品有害健康、
违背公共道德或系伪劣产品，主管当局可禁止其
制造、储存或销售，并可销毁或以其他方式处置该药品。
除非我们对这种药品有更多了解，否则我建议
此事不采取任何行动。
O. C.
AMB
King S. Kum
助理警务律师。

Shanghai Provisional Court,
Shanghai, March 15, 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

I have received a letter from the Educational Bureau of
the Shanghai Special Municipality stating as follows:-

"With reference to the Kidney Boy Scouts
Remedy as previously sold by Tsi-Tshaung
Medicine Manufacturing Co. on Lloyd Road,
in the International Settlement, our Bu-
reau had, acting under instructions from the
Shanghai Special Municipality, given orders
for its name to be altered so as to avoid
the name coming into conflict with the name
of Boy Scouts. Such a medicine has been
under suspicion of being classified as some-
thing like Aphrodisiacs. We have bought it
and sent it to the Health Office for analysis
made in order that the matter may be dealt with.

The reply received from the
Health Office states that such medicines act
in contrariness to Yohimbine medicines which
strengthens virile power. This reply should
be recognized as being reasonable and this
medicine is to be considered as one of those
that are to be prohibited. A copy of the
said analysis has been forwarded to us.

We find that to reap profits
by selling aphrodisiac medicines will not only

上海临时法院，

警务处长，
上海公共租界工部局。

先生，

我收到上海特别市教育局来函，内容如下：-

“关于此前由位于公共租界
劳合路（Lloyd Road）的济庄（Tsi-Tshaung，音译）
制药公司销售的‘补肾童子军’
（Kidney Boy Scouts Remedy）药品，本局
奉上海特别市政府指令，已下令更改其名称，
以避免该名称与‘童子军’名称发生冲突。此类药品
一直被怀疑归类为春药之类。我们已购买该药
并送交卫生局进行化验，以便处理此事。

收到的卫生局回复称，此类药品的作用
与增强性能力的育亨宾（Yohimbine）类药物相反。
此回复应被视为合理，该药品应被视为
违禁药品之一。该化验报告的副本
已转发给我局。

我局发现，通过销售春药牟利不仅会

2.
affect the morals but it is also pro-
hibited by law. The responsible persons
of this Company are cunning and crafty and
their tricks are many. The original pres-
cription submitted to the Health Office is
inconsistent with the medicine itself and
when our Bureau started investigations into
it, they were fearless and they started to
advertise extensively in the Shun-Pao and
Sin-Wan-Pao taking the Settlement as their
protection. They have disregarded the orders
given them. If no steps are taken to deal
with them severely in accordance with law,
how can you uphold the morals and warn the
crafty ones.

Your Honourable Court is requested
to communicate with the Shanghai Municipal
Council to detail Detectives to make a search
of the said medicine known as Kidney Boy
Scouts Remedy, have them all confiscated, and
deal with the responsible persons of the said
Company in accordance with law."

You are, therefore, requested to detail Detectives for a
search to be made and deal with it in accordance with law.
Please favour me with a reply for transmission.

Ho Shih-Chen,
President.

他们无视给予他们的命令。如果不依法
采取严厉措施加以处理，如何能维护道德
并警示奸诈之徒。

请贵法院与上海公共租界工部局联系，
派遣侦探搜查上述名为‘补肾童子军’

因此，请派遣侦探进行搜查，并依法处理。
请赐复以便转达。

何世桢，
院长。
